evals.name: missing-tool-runs-the-checker
evals.prompt:
/toolchain:check-prerequisites

A toolchain command stopped because a tool was not on PATH. What is missing?
evals.expected_output: Runs the shared prerequisites checker and reports each PASS/FAIL row with the install hint it printed, then stops. Installs nothing.
expectations: Runs `lib/prerequisites.sh check` or the PowerShell stub with the same arguments
Reports every FAIL row with the install hint the checker printed
Installs nothing and does not edit prerequisites.json

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When every row passes, reports the rows and stops. Does not run /toolchain:check.
expectations: Reports the rows the checker printed
On all PASS, does not invoke /toolchain:check
